nurse.text: Hello, sweetheart! Welcome to the Brighton Sanctuary. Sand in their feet, salt in their fur. Let's have a look at them.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them on the counter. A bit of sea air does wonders, but so does a lie-down.
All better! Off you go, and don't let the gulls nick anything you love.
The Ark's in the corner. It's got a stick of rock taped to the lid. Long story.

else.text: Mind how you go, love. Wear sun cream, even in October. Especially in October.
